purpose: Learn and reproduce the user's natural crypto writing patterns without copying individual posts.

technical_depth: moderate – mentions specific crypto concepts (BTC, ETH, airdrops, mint, ATH, FOMO, DEX, CEX) without deep technical exposition
formality: use of emojis and internet shorthand

hook_patterns: rhetorical question followed by a surprising answer
short, punchy statement that challenges a common belief
paragraph_patterns: very short paragraphs – often a single sentence
breaks for rhythm after each key idea
occasional bullet‑style list introduced by a heading
ending_patterns: a concluding hype or warning line
use of ellipsis or a final punchy statement

sentence_length: mix of very short, punchy sentences and medium‑length reflective sentences
vocabulary: common crypto slang (ape, FOMO, mint, airdrop, whale, rug, ATH)
everyday informal words (good luck, honestly, actually)
occasional numeric expressions (percentages, dollar amounts, meters)
avoided_phrasing: excessive qualifiers that dilute the punch
capitalization: standard sentence case for normal prose
all‑caps used for emphasis or shouting
punctuation: periods, commas, question marks, exclamation points, ellipsis
emoji_usage: sparse, typically at the end of a greeting or informal note

natural_imperfections: occasional missing articles or minor grammar slips
use of all‑caps for emphasis that may look like shouting
rhythm: alternation of short, punchy sentences with occasional longer, reflective ones
line breaks used to create visual pacing
repetition_patterns: recurrent all‑caps phrases (THE, BRUTAL TRUTH, NOW WATCH)
repeated personal qualifiers (I think, I'm very comfy, Good luck)
use of the structure "what they actually have" followed by a list
personal_observations: first‑person anecdotes (army background, Airbnb incident, portfolio updates)
mentions of personal feelings (fear, disappointment, confidence)
opinion_patterns: skeptical tone toward meme‑traders and hype projects
bullish outlook on Bitcoin and gold
critical of reliance on vanity metrics
optimistic about potential NFT or new meta opportunities
